claim: Maize was domesticated more than 9000 years ago.
source: Maize was domesticated more than 9000 years ago (Piperno et al., 2009) from its common ancestor with the extant annual grass teosinte, but traditional open-pollinated populations maintain large population sizes and a surprising amount of diversity (Bellon et al., 2018).
evidence: The claim is supported by a citation to Piperno et al., 2009.

claim: Traditional open-pollinated maize populations maintain large population sizes and a surprising amount of diversity.

evidence: The claim is supported by citations to Van Heerwaarden et al., 2010, Hufford et al., 2011, and Takou et al., 2024.

claim: Within subspecies, populations were genetically distinct from one another.
